timingAccuracy.reason: Onset times come from the review UI: recognizer-origin events use the recognizer's detected event start (which itself can deviate slightly from the perceptual/spectral onset), inserted-manual events are hand-placed on the timeline, and inserted-slot events use a dropped-segment boundary.
timingAccuracy.refinement: Optional. An agent or human can re-verify onset times with spectral analysis and, if done, raise the per-onset method to spectrogram_verified / aubio_cross_checked. Not required unless a timing-sensitive use needs it.
